## Split into sub-issues

This umbrella has been decomposed into tracked sub-issues (each links back here, labeled by priority):

**🔴 P0 — security enforcement (`priority:p0` + `security`)**
- #1882 — PolicySchema is 100% dead — enforce or remove
- #1883 — Permission lifecycle ops ungated (allowTransfer/allowRestore/allowPurge)
- #1884 — Agent access control is a no-op (permissions/visibility/access)
- #1888 — Flow runAs never switches execution identity
- #1889 — Object apiEnabled/apiMethods not enforced by REST
- #1885 — Action disabled (CEL form) silently ignored
- #1886 — Role parent dead — manager-rollup unimplemented
- #1887 — SharingRuleSchema disconnected from the live engine

**🔴 P1 — analytics (`priority:p1`)**
- #1890 — Finish ADR-0021 migration (chart view / dashboard+Studio / report)

**🟠 P2 — spec hygiene (`priority:p2`)**
- #1891 — Naming drift → silent no-ops
- #1892 — Write-only / disconnected metadata
- #1893 — Aspirational config — prune or mark experimental
- #1894 — Inverse drift — renderers read undeclared props
- #1895 — Designer authoring gaps (live prop, no Studio editor)

The audit's suggested 3-ADR grouping maps to: **Security enforcement** (the P0 set), **Finish ADR-0021** (#1890), **Spec hygiene** (the P2 set).

## Staged plan for the P0 security cluster — ADR-0049

Decision recorded in **ADR-0049** (`docs/adr/0049-no-unenforced-security-properties.md`): a spec property naming a security boundary must be **enforced**, explicitly **`experimental`**, or **absent** — never parsed-but-silently-unenforced (that's a *false sense of compliance*).

Given the platform's pre-MVP stage, the cluster splits by **whether the feature already exists** — we do *not* build enforcement for features that don't exist yet:

| Disposition | Items | Action now |
|---|---|---|
| **Feature absent → mark `experimental` / remove** | #1882 Policy · #1883 lifecycle bits · #1887 SharingRule (spec form) · #1888 flow `runAs` | stop the spec from promising; re-introduce *with* the feature at M2 |
| **Feature live, gate missing → enforce** | #1884 agent access · #1889 object apiEnabled · #1885 action disabled | localized route/renderer check now |
| **No-regret correctness fix** | evaluator fail-open | fail CLOSED for destructive ops |

### PR A (no-regret, shipped on branch `fix/p0-unenforced-security-props-1878`)
- `PermissionEvaluator` fails **closed** for the destructive op class (transfer/restore/purge) instead of default-allow.
- `allowTransfer`/`allowRestore`/`allowPurge` marked `[EXPERIMENTAL — not enforced]` (#1883).
- Covers ADR-0049 + the #1883 disposition. Tests green (68 plugin + 152 spec).

### PR B (next) — real gaps where the feature is live
- #1884 agent route hardcoded perms → enforce `permissions`/`visibility`/`access`.
- #1889 object `apiEnabled`/`apiMethods` → gate REST routes.
- #1885 action `disabled` CEL → evaluate predicate in renderer.

### Deferred to M2/production (heavy, feature + enforcement together)
- #1882 PolicySchema registration + enforcement points.
- #1887 SharingRule engine reconciliation (depends on #1886 role `parent`).
- #1888 flow `runAs` identity switching.

### PRs open for the P0 cluster (ADR-0049)

- **objectstack-ai/framework#1899** — PR A (evaluator fail-closed + `allowTransfer/Restore/Purge` marked experimental, #1883) **+** PR B (#1884 agent access enforcement, #1889 object `apiEnabled`/`apiMethods` enforcement).
- **objectstack-ai/objectui#1743** — #1885 action `disabled` (CEL) now consumed by the renderer.

Deferred to M2 (feature + enforcement together): #1882 Policy, #1887 SharingRule, #1888 flow `runAs`, #1886 role `parent`.

## Closing the umbrella — audit delivered, disposition fully split out

The audit this issue tracked is **done** and has been operationalized into a standing system, and every checklist item has been split into its own labeled, independently-tracked sub-issue. Keeping this umbrella open now only duplicates that tracking, so closing it.

### What the audit became (standing system, not a one-off)
- **Spec-liveness gate** — `packages/spec/liveness/*.json` ledgers + `packages/spec/scripts/liveness/check-liveness.mts`, wired as the blocking `Spec property liveness` CI check. Every authorable property of 10 governed types is classified live/experimental/dead **with evidence**; the ratchet blocks new undeclared surface. This is the living source of truth that replaces the static audit docs.
- **Cross-repo correctness** — the original audit missed objectui's metadata-admin authoring layer; a cross-repo re-audit corrected ~25 props dead→live (#1956 et al.). A **monthly drift re-audit cron** now catches dead→live drift the completeness gate can't.
- **Author-side loop closed (#1966)** — `objectstack compile` now warns when an author/AI sets a misleading dead/experimental property (`enable.feeds`, `field.columnName`, …) with a corrective hint. Measurement → gate → drift-cron → author-prevention.

### Shipped against the checklist
- ✅ **Object `apiEnabled`/`apiMethods` enforced by REST** (#1937) — `enforceApiAccess`, 404/405.
- ✅ **Agent access control** — already enforced via `evaluateAgentAccess` at the chat route; ledger corrected (the audit predated it).
- ✅ **Record clone productized** — `enable.clone` was dead; now a real runtime (#1961), reclassified live.
- ✅ **Aspirational prune (partial)** — orphaned `recordTypes` + `cdc` removed (#1960).

### Remaining items — each tracked in its own open issue (nothing orphaned)
- 🔴 P0 security: PolicySchema #1882 · permission lifecycle ops #1883 · role `parent` #1886 · SharingRule #1887 · flow `runAs` #1888
- 🟠 P1 analytics migration #1890
- 🟡 P2: naming drift #1891 · write-only metadata #1892 · aspirational prune-or-experimental #1893 · inverse drift #1894 · designer authoring gaps #1895
- Action `disabled` CEL — objectui renderer side.

Closing as completed (deliverable shipped + operationalized); execution continues in the sub-issues above.

## Remaining-work evaluation + first hygiene PRs

Re-audited every open sub-issue against current code (`file:line`-verified). Two findings up front:

1. **The P0 cluster is effectively done** — all closed except #1883, which is *intentionally* `[experimental]` + fail-closed and deferred to the 11.0 epic #2364 (enforcement is additive once the transfer/restore/purge ops exist). Not a blocker.
2. **The five P2 issues had drifted far from reality** — much was already fixed by follow-up PRs but the checkboxes were never updated. Verified resolved-ness per issue:

| Sub-issue | Verified state | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| #1891 naming drift | ~55% | field/page/action/skill ✅ reconciled; app/agent/webhook ❌ still drifted |
| #1892 write-only | ~50% | Email + SharingRule now bridged ✅; **tool** executor + spec-bridge orphans ❌ |
| #1893 aspirational | ~50% | field prune + agent/tool experimental ✅; job/theme/translation/webhook-auth/**Portal** ❌ |
| #1894 inverse drift | ~5% | essentially untouched — dashboard/view/app renderer reads undeclared props |
| #1895 designer gaps | ~67% (by prop) | dataset inspector ✅; skill `triggerConditions` + flow `notify` ❌ |

### Shipped now (two draft PRs)
**framework #3223** — spec hygiene:
- **#1893**: `[EXPERIMENTAL — not enforced]` markers on object `enable.trash`/`mru` (ledger `dead→experimental`), job `retryPolicy`/`timeout`, theme `spacing`/`breakpoints`/`rtl`/`density`/`touchTarget`, translation `messageFormat:'icu'`/`cache`, webhook non-HMAC `authentication`, and the **entire `PortalSchema`** (unregistered, no route/renderer).
- **#1891/#1894 (app cluster)**: declared the props objectui already reads so strict `Schema.parse()` holds — app branding `accentColor`, nav `badgeVariant`, nav `separator` type; agent `knowledge.sources` promoted to canonical (`topics` kept as deprecated alias).
- Gates green: `check:liveness`, `check:docs` (253 files regenerated), `check:spec-changes`; full spec suite **6763 passing**.

**objectui #2666** — renderer/designer:
- **#1891**: `DashboardGridLayout` now falls back to `schema.label` (spec-canonical) instead of only `title` → spec-compliant dashboards get their header.
- **#1895**: skill authoring form gains `surface` / `triggerPhrases` / `triggerConditions` editors (were hand-edit-only).

### Genuinely remaining (needs a maintainer decision, not just mechanical work)
- **#1894** dashboard `component`/`data`/`rowField`/`columnField` + view `ObjectView` form-adapter keys — each needs a call: *legitimately authorable* (declare in spec) vs *renderer-internal escape hatch* (drop the dep). `dataset`/`values` being required by ADR-0021 makes a blanket declaration wrong, so I left it out deliberately.
- **#1892** tool executor/handler binding + spec-bridge removal (test-only orphans).
- **#1895** flow `notify` palette node — needs node rendering + config panel + browser verification, not just a palette entry.
- **#1893** the remaining aspirational items are now *marked*, but the underlying prune-vs-build decisions still belong in each sub-issue.

Suggest re-checking the sub-issue checkboxes against the table above (several are stale-open). Once #3223/#2666 land, #1891/#1893/#1895 drop to a small, well-scoped tail; #1894 is the one that most needs a design call.

## Re-closing — every tracked row resolved (or deliberately deferred)

Reopened 2026-07-18 to attach a remaining-work evaluation. That tail has now landed; the umbrella is back to done.

### Final state of the 14 original sub-issues
**13 CLOSED**, 1 intentionally open:
- 🔴 P0 security (8): #1882 #1884 #1885 #1886 #1887 #1888 #1889 closed; **#1883** open by design — `allow{Transfer,Restore,Purge}` are `[experimental]` + evaluator fail-closed; enforcement is additive once the transfer/restore/purge ops exist. Downgraded p0→p2 (no home after epic #2364 closed).
- 🔴 P1 analytics: #1890 closed (ADR-0021 migration).
- 🟠 P2 hygiene (5): #1891 #1892 #1893 #1894 #1895 all closed.

### Systemic follow-ups (the ledger-gap issues the audit spun off) — all closed today
- #3461 webhook disconnect → **#3489** materializes stack-declared webhooks into the `sys_webhook` dispatcher (built the ingestion path, not a spec retreat).
- #3462 GOVERNED enrollment → report/dashboard via **#3474**, webhook via **#3485**. The liveness ratchet now covers every round-trippable type.
- #3464 PortalSchema → **#3486** `feat(spec)!` prunes the dead schema.

### Last executional tail (not umbrella-blocking)
- objectstack-ai/objectui#2817 — deletes the dead `spec-bridge` page/dashboard bridges (`@object-ui/react` major); the objectui-side execution of #1892. Awaiting CI/merge.
- #3492 — webhook i18n cleanup tail of #3489.

The audit is delivered, operationalized (liveness gate + monthly drift cron + `objectstack compile` author-warn), and its entire checklist is resolved. Closing as completed; #1883 continues on its own at p2.

## Recheck: the "parsed-but-unenforced security props" cluster (§1 of the audit) is largely closed

Re-verified the cluster this umbrella called out as "the most serious — false compliance," against **current** code (three independent read-only passes). The 2026-06 framing is now substantially stale; the gap was closed the right way. Full per-property table with `file:line` evidence + a doc annotation of the two stale audits: objectstack-ai/objectstack#3503 (`docs/audits/2026-07-security-props-liveness-recheck.md`).

**Enforced now** (was flagged dead): password/MFA/lockout/session policy (ADR-0069 auth settings), Permission `allowTransfer` (#3004), Object `apiEnabled`/`apiMethods` on both REST surfaces (#1937 + `import`/`export` #3391), Flow `runAs`, ADR-0057 hierarchy scope + criteria-type SharingRules.

**Correctly pruned** (not left dead): `PolicySchema` was *deleted* (#2387, ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove) and rebuilt as enforced settings; agent `visibility`/`tenantId` removed (#1901/#2377); `role.parent` never existed — positions are flat (ADR-0090).

**Roadmap / out-of-repo**: `allowRestore`/`allowPurge` pre-mapped + fail-closed (ops M2-pending); agent `access`/`permissions` enforced in the closed `service-ai` runtime.

### Genuine remaining loose ends (small)
1. Prune `AuditRetentionPolicySchema` (`system/audit.zod.ts`) — real parsed-only dead schema; retention lives on the `lifecycle` surface.
2. Enforce-or-prune SharingRule `owner`-type rules + `group`/`guest` recipients (criteria-type already enforces; the rest silently no-op).
3. Per-org / per-user IP allow-list — global-only today (#2571).
4. Ledger/comment drift: `authz-conformance.matrix.ts` still marks `flow-run-as` removed (it's live); the agent `access` schema comment claims in-repo enforcement (it's in the untracked `service-ai/dist`).

None of these is a live authored-but-silently-unenforced access-control gap of the kind §1 warned about — they're cleanup + one tracked feature (#2571). Suggest §1 can be marked rechecked/largely-resolved on this umbrella once #3503 lands.

SharingRule loose end from the recheck (#3503) closed by objectstack-ai/objectstack#3557: authoring `ShareRecipientType` reconciled with the enforced runtime — `group` renamed → `team` (wired to the live `TeamGraphService` expansion), `business_unit` added, `guest` pruned (anonymous access = public-form grant / share links), and the never-enforced owner-type rules removed (return if membership-reactive re-materialisation is designed). Every authorable recipient/rule type now enforces (ADR-0078); proven on a real boot — the migrated showcase rule seeds (ruleCount 4→5) with `criteria_json` `{done:false}`. Remaining from the recheck: AuditConfig-cluster prune decision (needs an owner call on dead-vs-roadmap) and per-org IP allow-list (#2571).

## 2026-07 dead-cluster sweep — disposition record (8 PRs)

Follow-through of the recheck above: the report slice, the security-props cluster, and three chained dead-config clusters are now fully dispositioned. Recording here so triage of the remaining audit sections doesn't re-excavate.

| Cluster | PRs | Disposition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Report dead exports (`ReportColumn`/`ReportGrouping` + objectui `SpecReport*` re-exports, `chart.groupBy`, legacy `ReportViewer` chart fallback) | #3488 / objectui#2816 (#3463) | removed; live path = dataset-bound `DatasetReportRenderer` |
| Report `aria`/`performance` + chart dogfood + stale audit refresh | #3496 | pruned; `report.chart` confirmed **live** (audit's "dead" claim corrected); showcase chart report added |
| Security-props recheck + ledger fix | #3503, #3506 | cluster largely closed (see comment above); `flow-run-as` reclassified enforced |
| `AuditConfig` cluster (`system/audit.zod.ts`, whole module) | #3593 | removed — live audit = plugin-audit always-on capture + `trackHistory` + lifecycle `audit` retention + settings overrides |
| Static capabilities descriptor (`ObjectQL`/`ObjectUI`/`Kernel`/`ObjectStack`/`ObjectOS CapabilitiesSchema`) | #3605 / objectui#2860 | removed — defaults contradicted the live platform (FLS/RLS/audit `default(false)` while enforced); live discovery = `GET /api/v1/discovery` (declared===enforced) + `/.well-known` |
| Orphaned `FeatureFlagSchema` module (`kernel/feature.zod.ts`) | #3630 | removed — protocol home died with #3605; live toggles = `feature_flags` settings manifest + `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES` |

Pattern note for the remaining sections (§3 naming drift, §4 aspirational, §5 write-only): these clusters chain — each removal exposed the next orphan (`AuditConfig` → `auditLogging` boolean → capabilities descriptor → `FeatureFlagSchema`). Worth pulling each thread to its end rather than pruning single symbols. All removals shipped as `minor` per the launch-window policy, each changeset carrying a dead-knob → live-surface migration table.

Next confirmed actionable from the recheck: the objectui `action.disabled` wire-rename (spec declares `disabled` CEL; the renderer reads non-spec `enabled` — authored predicates silently no-op).
